title: Actor-spoofing class: 5 endpoints persist a client-supplied actor into DB audit columns
members: POST /api/org/people/:id/terminate — body.actorId → EmployeeActivityEvent.actorId + ProjectPositionFillHistory.changedByPersonId (person-directory.controller.ts:102; terminate-employee.service.ts:61,69,91). Sibling deactivate is correct.
POST /api/cases/:id/comments — body.authorPersonId → CaseRecord.updatedByPersonId + comment author (cases.controller.ts:407; prisma-case-comment.service.ts:40)
rootCause: These handlers read the actor from @Body() and persist it as the canonical audit author, with no req.principal override. The vast majority of write endpoints (rate-cards, budget, feature-flags, sso, help, project lifecycle submit/approve/reject/close, org bulk-reassign, teams, reporting-lines, undo, project-positions create/transition) correctly source the actor from req.principal — these 5 are the outliers.
userImpact: Any user authorized for the endpoint can forge the audit trail / attribution to an arbitrary personId.
suggestedFix: Source the actor from req.principal.personId server-side and ignore/strip any body-supplied actor field across all 5. Pair with F-WP-2 (the interface bindings are why the body actor isn't stripped). Audit the remaining schema-only actor columns per the D-103 write-path item.
soundScope: fin-admin (18 handlers), most org/positions/cases/integrations writes — verified to use req.principal. Integrations hardcode actorId:null. exceptions resolve/suppress + admin webhook read body actor but sink to in-memory stores (not DB) — data smell, not DB spoof.

title: Undecorated @Body() DTOs: interfaces pass unvalidated bodies through; undecorated classes get whitelist-stripped to empty → silent no-op

subclasses.interface-passthrough (unvalidated, enab: planner/apply (PlannerApplyRequestDto), planner/scenarios (CreatePlannerScenarioDto), team-builder (TeamBuilderRequestDto) bind @Body() to TS INTERFACES — no runtime metatype, so ValidationPipe cannot validate or whitelist-strip; the full body (incl actorId) passes through to Prisma.
subclasses.undecorated-class-stripped (SILENT NO-OP: PATCH /api/projects/:id (UpdateProjectRequestDto, projects.controller.ts:60-66) is a CLASS with name/description/projectManagerId/deliveryManagerId and ZERO class-validator decorators. With whitelist:true (main.ts:64-70), class-validator STRIPS all undecorated props → the service receives an empty object → the project update SILENTLY SAVES NOTHING (200 OK, edits lost). Same undecorated-class pattern (lower impact): PATCH /api/org/reporting-lines/:id (TerminateReportingLineRequestDto), POST/PATCH /api/resource-pools[/:id][/members].

userImpact: Project edits (name/description/PM/DM) via PATCH /projects/:id appear to succeed but persist nothing (P2 data-loss). Planner/team-builder accept arbitrary unvalidated/malformed bodies (P2).
suggestedFix: Convert every @Body() target to a class-validator DTO CLASS with proper @IsString/@IsUUID/@IsOptional/@IsDateString decorators. This both validates AND lets whitelist work correctly (keeps decorated props, strips the rest). Verifies-fixes F-WP-1 spoofing (strips body actorId) and the UpdateProject no-op (keeps the real fields).
evidence: projects.controller.ts:60-66,290-305 (UpdateProjectRequestDto no decorators); main.ts:64-70 (whitelist:true); workforce-planner.service.ts:144 / planner-scenario.service.ts:28 / team-builder.service.ts:12 (interfaces); reporting-lines.controller.ts:23-25; resource-pools.controller.ts:29-43.

title: Dashboard KPI drilldowns emit filter params the destination pages silently drop → land on unfiltered lists
rootCause: Destination list pages use useFilterParams(defaults) (useFilterParams.ts:22-28) which only reads URL params whose KEY is in the page's defaults set; any other param is silently dropped. KPI drilldown links across dashboards emit params the pages don't define, so the drilldown lands on the full unfiltered list. Compounded by case-sensitive value matching ('ACTIVE' !== 'active') and wrong param NAMES (status vs lifecycleStatus).
members: Director At-risk 7 vs 40 — /projects?rag=AMBER,RED (rag not a ProjectsPage filter key) [F-DC-2]
HR Active Employees 200 vs 201 — /people?status=active (directory key is lifecycleStatus, lowercase, + count-definition drift ACTIVE+LEAVE) [F-DC-6]
RM Idle Resources 5 vs 198 — /people?filter=idle (filter not a directory key; correct target is ?view=bench) [F-DC-8]; duplicated in ResourcePoolUtilizationDonut.tsx:19
Workload Active Projects 10 vs 40 — bare /projects link, no status param [F-DC-7]
Director Open positions 36 vs 33 — unit mismatch (positions vs projects) [F-DC-4]
Director Budget variance — /projects?budgetStatus=over, 'over' not in GREEN|YELLOW|RED enum → always 0 [F-DC-5]
RM Managed People 5 vs 198 — bare /people, no manager-scope filter (soft)
consistentControls: Director Active projects (uppercase ?status=ACTIVE) = 10 ✓; Workload Active Positions/Available People/Open Issues ✓; HR Total Headcount/Data Issues/At Risk/Open Cases ✓; bench badge 135=135 ✓.
userImpact: Clicking a KPI of N lands on a list of a different size — pervasive Law-9 violation across director/DM/HR/RM/exec/workload dashboards; undermines trust and makes drilldowns useless for the at-risk/idle/over-budget triage they're meant for.
suggestedFix: Per KPI: emit only filter params the destination page's filter schema defines (and add the missing keys: rag on ProjectsPage, a real idle/bench filter, manager-scope), normalize case in value comparisons, fix param names (status→lifecycleStatus), and reconcile unit (positions vs projects). Consider an integration test asserting each KPI value == its drilldown count.

title: PATCH /api/admin/platform-settings/:key reads actor from req.user (never populated) → every setting change has a null actor
rootCause: platform-settings.controller.ts:63 reads actorId from req.user?.personId ?? req.user?.sub, but the auth middleware only sets request.principal (request-principal.middleware.ts:12) — request.user is undefined everywhere. So updatedBy/updatedByPersonId/createdByPersonId persist as null on every platform-setting change (platform-settings.service.ts:362-372).
suggestedFix: Source from req.principal like every other admin controller.

title: Audit-attribution gaps: writes that don't thread the available principal into createdBy/updatedBy
members: help-admin updateArticle (help-admin.controller.ts:85) + createTip (:94) — don't pass req.principal → editor/creator columns null (help.service.ts:177,215-216)
POST /api/admin/people/import/confirm (admin-config.controller.ts:304-313) — prisma.person.create with no createdByPersonId despite principal available
suggestedFix: Thread req.principal.personId into these create/update calls. Low priority (audit completeness, no security/correctness impact).
